data.title: 间桐樱 · 卫宫家月夜的温柔与晦暗
data.description: 【成年 After Story · 间桐樱 · 月夜黑丝褪落】二十岁以上成年后的樱独坐在卧室床沿，柔软梅色开衫敞开，紫色长发散在枕边。她双手把一条黑色连裤袜从成熟大腿缓慢卷向脚踝，另一条腿仍被薄纱包裹，裸足在月光前蜷起；烹饪笔记压在被角，紫眸中的温柔不再依附任何人——「现在的幸福不是偷来的……连选择让谁看见，也由我自己决定。」
data.promptProse: Seen from a low three-quarter angle, Adult Sakura sits on the bed, rolling one leg of her tights toward her ankle with both hands; the other leg stays covered and one bare foot faces the camera. Cold moonlight and soft violet shadows fall across the bedding.
data.action: 成年樱坐在床沿，开衫敞开，双手将一侧黑丝从大腿卷至脚踝，另一腿保持完整薄纱
data.lighting: cold silver moonlight, soft violet shadows, gentle window glow
data.camera: medium shot, low three-quarter view, bent legs and both hands on the tights visible
data.animaCaption: Both hands roll one leg of her tights toward the ankle while the other leg stays covered.
